'''2012 Bespin Regionals Scott Morgan DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Morgan]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif|label=A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage}}
* '''Username:''' boshek1
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
